clusters.headline: Train Collision Occurs In Giza Province Resulting In Casualties
aiSummaryBullets: A train collision in the al-Ayyat district of Giza province resulted in multiple fatalities and over 100 injuries.
The incident involved one train striking the rear of another, which caused one of the trains to derail.

clusters.headline: Egyptian National Football Team Appoints Ali Maher As Head Coach
aiSummaryBullets: The Egyptian national football team has confirmed the departure of its previous coach, Hassan.
Ali Maher has been appointed as the new head coach for the national team.
